text:
[issue by ModernGamingWorld]
### Checklist

- [ ] I am reporting a defect, not asking for help
- [x] I have searched existing issues and this has not been reported
- [x] I have reduced my mod list to the minimum required to reproduce this issue (see below)

### Bug Description

Hi there, Embeddedt. I have recently updated all my mods that need to be updated in my current custom modpack, and now my modpack crashes and blames dynamic resources being enabled. The only thing I can guess is the latest version of JEI caused this because JEI did backport a lot of changes from 1.21, and lately mod devs backporting changes from 1.21.1 have been causing issues. Idk if this is the issue or something else. But I figured the best place was to bring the issue here with hopes of any answer on what's going on.

### Minimal Mod List

This would be hard for me to do. Since my modpack has over 700ish mods

### Reproduction Steps

1. Update all the current mods in my custom modpack
2. Launch said modpack after updating the mods that I could.
3. Then it crashed to desktop with an error saying Dynamicresources is to blame

### Diagnostic Info

[debug.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30683641/debug.log)

[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30683645/latest.log)

[comment by MarioSMB (none)]

[comment by embeddedt (owner)]
As mentioned above the report is not possible to properly investigate since there are 700 mods and no minimal reproduction steps given. However, an analysis of the contents of the log suggests Lightspeed is likely the problem. I recommend removing it; it shouldn't be needed with current versions of ModernFix.
